mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may be exacerbated by concurrent use; efavirenz has CNS and metabolic effects that complicate adverse effect monitoring.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes, and CNS effects closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy and consider dose adjustments based on creatinine clearance.
